passages.provision_quote: Prohibits a governmental entity or any other person from knowingly or willfully keeping any list, record, or registry of: (1) privately owned firearms; or (2) the owners of firearms; with respect to Indiana consumers.
passages.note: Bars firearm-owner registries and payment-network discrimination against firearms retailers; not the ladder's ownership/carry-restriction dimension.

passages.provision_quote: Prohibits a governmental entity or any other person from knowingly or willfully keeping any list, record, or registry of: (1) privately owned firearms; or (2) the owners of firearms; with respect to Indiana consumers.
passages.note: Also amends capitol-carry rights for specific legislators, staff, and state officers — a narrow institutional carve-out, not general civilian carry loosening.

rows.reasoning: Both passages show Teshka's own act as author of HB 1084 (2024), but the bill's operative content — banning firearm-owner registries/tracking and barring payment-network discrimination against firearms retailers, plus a narrow capitol-carry provision limited to specific legislators, staff, and state officers — does not address the ladder's ownership/carry-restriction dimension ('How should the government regulate firearms?', from an outright ownership ban to permitless carry), so no rung's operative clauses are matched.
